verdict.rationale: Formant's docs say users can build analytics dashboards with 'our AI assistant' (formant-docs-7/25), and its product page describes asking the fleet questions in plain language and getting ML-driven task recommendations that people approve (formant-docs-12/23). This is a first-party built-in assistant, but the evidence shows it only for dashboard building and recommendations, not broad hands-off task delegation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the assistant's capabilities and scope, evidence that it can carry out actions or tasks end-to-end beyond dashboards and recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
